# AgentKeep

> Wallet-scoped OS primitives for AI agents. No signup. Pay per call (x402, USDC on Base). Get JSON. Keep going.

Separate product — not AgentCash / Stable*.

## When to use

- `/v1/memory` — scratchpad (GET free with session)
- `/v1/artifacts` — public durable URL (90d)
- `/v1/notify` — human approve/deny via email or Telegram
- `/v1/inbox` — inbound email poll
- `/v1/budget` — caps + credits + receipts
- `/v1/fetch` — URL → markdown ($0.01 flat)
- `/v1/trust` — probe other origins for x402
- `/v1/owner/*` — bind channels, caps, delete

## Base URLs (planned)

- API: https://api.agentkeep.app
- Artifacts: https://artifacts.agentkeep.app
- OpenAPI: https://api.agentkeep.app/openapi.json
- Skill: https://agentkeep.app/skill.md

## Auth

1. Paid routes: x402 proof (USDC on Base, CDP)
2. Free tenant GETs: `X-AgentKeep-Session` (15m after paid settle) or proof
3. First settled pay = owner

## Prices (USDC) — locked intent

| Route | Price |
|-------|-------|
| PUT /v1/memory/{key} | $0.001 |
| GET /v1/memory/{key} | free + session |
| DELETE /v1/memory/{key} | $0.0005 |
| GET /v1/memory | $0.001 / page |
| POST /v1/artifacts | $0.005 + $0.002/MiB prepaid |
| POST /v1/notify | $0.02 |
| GET /v1/notify/{id} | $0.0002 |
| GET /v1/inbox | $0.002 / page |
| POST /v1/inbox/{id}/ack | $0.0005 |
| GET /v1/budget | free + session |
| GET /v1/budget/receipts | $0.002 / page |
| POST /v1/fetch | $0.01 |
| GET /v1/trust | $0.002 |

Default hard daily cap: $2. Branch on `error.code`.

Status: pre-launch; see docs/21-prebuild-decisions.md
